page_title: RBL 3-1 UNI | RB Leipzig v Union Berlin 24/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+2' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) will replace Antonio Nusa.
89' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
88' It looks like Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) saw red with that tackle. Sven Jablonski won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. RB Leipzig win a free kick.
84' Sven Jablonski shows the yellow card to Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) for a heavy challenge.
83' Substitution. Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) on for Andras Schafer.
82' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) picked up a rebound and unleashed a fine effort which crashed against the left post.
82' Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
82' The game is interrupted now, Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
81' There's an opportunity for Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
80' Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
79' Ole Werner has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) replacing Ridle Baku.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yan Diomande departs the field of play to be replaced by Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig).

78' 3 - 1 A perfectly taken corner kick. Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) gets on the end of it and produces a fantastic bullet header from around the penalty spot into the roof of the net, increasing the score of today's match – 3:1.
78' The ball is out of play. Union Berlin win a corner kick.

75' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
72' The attendance is 47800.

71' RB Leipzig slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
68' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) replaces Romulo Cardoso.
68' Substitution. Assan Ouedraogo is replaced by Conrad Harder (RB Leipzig).
67' Flag goes up against Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
63' 3 - 0 Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.

62' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
61' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) will take a corner kick.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Trimmel trots off the pitch and is replaced by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
60' Substitution. Janik Haberer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin).
59' Marie-Louise Eta has decided to substitute Andrej Ilic and he is replaced by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin).
58' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
56' Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) takes the corner.

56' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. RB Leipzig have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
55' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
52' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

51' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies way over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.
50' Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) prepares to take a corner kick.
48' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Union Berlin.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' A pass by Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
45+2' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) dribbles into the box, but Maarten Vandevoordt is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
45+1' Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. RB Leipzig are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
43' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Sven Jablonski had a clear view and blows his whistle. RB Leipzig have been awarded a free kick.
41' The referee awards a corner and Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) goes over to take it.
40' Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) steps up to send the ball in.
37' Wonderful movement by RB Leipzig. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
36' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) brings an opponent down and Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. RB Leipzig will take a free kick.
34' The game is interrupted. Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.

34' Great movement by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig)! He jumps for a precise cross and produces a header towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper luckily denies the effort by pushing the ball onto the post.
32' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Maarten Vandevoordt comes off his line to intercept.
31' Frederik Ronnow has picked up an injury and is replaced by Carl Klaus (Union Berlin).
29' Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
29' A player from RB Leipzig commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
28' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) gets to a rebound and sends a header goalwards. His long-range effort from inside the box only hits the crossbar!
27' Corner kick. Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) is ready to send the ball into the box.
25' 2 - 0 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 2:0.
25' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and RB Leipzig will have a goal kick.

22' 1 - 0 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Max Finkgrafe (RB Leipzig) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Frederik Ronnow, so the score changes to 1:0.
20' A pass from Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) is intercepted by Maarten Vandevoordt and the move breaks down.
18' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
14' RB Leipzig earn a corner.

14' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. RB Leipzig will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' The ball possession is 69:31.
12' A pass by Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
10' RB Leipzig take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

9' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Frederik Ronnow is alert and denies him with a nice save. The linesman makes the right call and RB Leipzig will have a corner.
7' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) has an opportunity, but isn't able to direct the ball into the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.

7' Great solo effort by Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Frederik Ronnow is alert and denies him.
6' RB Leipzig are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
4' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
4' Oliver Burke (Union Berlin) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

2' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the middle of the goal, but Frederik Ronnow makes a nice save.
2' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) takes a direct free kick.
2' Sven Jablonski blows the whistle, Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. RB Leipzig are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Sven Jablonski will supervise the game today.
